label: practical
text: lit by a named source inside the frame
note: Name the fixture — neon, headlight, monitor, fire, candle, LED strip. An unnamed practical is not a practical.

label: overcast
text: flat overcast sky, no visible sun

label: motivated
text: artificial light shaped to imitate a source visible in frame
note: The A24 house habit. See studios/a24. Describes intent rather than an image property.

label: back
text: key from behind the subject, separating it from ground
note: The Endgame technique — backlight every figure so disparate CG elements share one ground.

label: diffused
text: source through diffusion, shadow nearly absent

label: specular
text: bright highlights on wet or polished surfaces

label: high key
text: low contrast, fill close to key, shadows open

label: low key
text: high contrast, little fill, shadows deep

label: chiaroscuro
text: single hard source, most of frame in shadow

label: overexposed daylight
note: The Midsommar register — dread in full sun rather than in dark. See studios/a24.
